svg.text: Frequency sweep: setpoint, requested and actual
Simulated from the AvrTimerPWM maths: 125 to 18000 Hz at 2000 Hz/s, prescaler 1, values as read over Modbus (whole Hz).
Requested reaches the setpoint, CODESYS switches to 125 Hz
the gap is too small to see here
Zoom on the end of the ramp up (8.55 to 9.05 s)
Actual: steps of ~40 Hz, one per TOP value
Rounding error of Actual vs Requested
Max error ≈ ±f² / 16 MHz: under 1 Hz below 4 kHz,
